answer_4.quote: We invited 30 coworkers for in-house evaluation and received feedback from 23 of them. In addition, we recruited 105 lay testers via Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for crowdsourcing evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Testers were asked: (1) Is the predicted triple correct? (using two scales: three options for in-house, five for crowdsourcing), (2) How confident is the assessment? (5-point Likert scale), (3) Is an explanation helpful? (yes/no).
